description: Right-clicking a Time Keeper as a player opens its trading screen with its offers, and closing the screen releases it. The Time Keeper stands on a platform in the sky with no AI, so it stays in front of the player. The player's inventory is cleared first: right-clicking with the Chronicle given on join in hand would open the Chronicle instead.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 16 0 31 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 20 200 4 28 200 12 minecraft:white_concrete
execute in minecraft:overworld run summon chronodawn:time_keeper 24.5 201 10.5 {NoAI:1b,Invulnerable:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f]}

steps.note: The Time Keeper stands right in front of the player on a white platform, the crosshair on its body. It renders with its texture (purple robe, gold trim, dark hood with glowing eyes).

The Time Keeper trading screen: the title reads Time Keeper, the offer list on the left shows its trades with item icons (no empty list, no magenta-black missing textures), and the player's inventory is below.

steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 16 0 31 15
